what: read-config.sh had a latent flat-vs-nested key mismatch with `.aide/config.json`. `runConfig` (src/cli/commands/memory/config.ts) writes nested (`{hooks:{correction:{enabled:false}}}`) via setNestedValue, but the old read-config.sh looked up flat keys (`jq ."hooks.correction.enabled"`). The public/pro gating hid this — user overrides were never exercised because all settings were private. Dropping gating (Option A) required fixing lookup to nested via getpath + path-existence reduce (jq's `//` collapses explicit false/null to the fallback, so can't be used to distinguish "missing" from "explicit false").
why: Non-obvious bug — runConfig and read-config.sh were silently incompatible. Any future change to config shape must keep them aligned. `//` operator also has a subtle false-handling gotcha worth remembering.
